notes: Kunath v. City of Seattle, No. 79447-7-I (published opinion). Held chapter 36.65 RCW (including RCW 36.65.030's ban on county/city net income taxes) unconstitutional under the single-subject rule, and held Seattle's graduated income tax unconstitutional under the uniformity requirement.
